sources.title: National hydrometric network basin polygons
sources.authority: Environment and Climate Change Canada / Water Survey of Canada
sources.scope: Official/prerelease drainage-area polygons for active and discontinued discharge stations; distributed by major drainage area.

sources.title: Hydrometric Network Basin Polygons — distribution directory
sources.authority: Environment and Climate Change Canada / Water Survey of Canada
sources.scope: Lists MDA_ADP_02.zip (337 MB) and MDA_ADP_03.zip (27 MB) GeoJSON packages used by this pass.

sources.title: Wateroffice drainage-basin delineation notice
sources.authority: Environment and Climate Change Canada / Water Survey of Canada
sources.scope: States basin polygons are prerelease and polygon-derived drainage areas may differ from official station drainage areas until final review.

sources.title: Updated drainage areas for WSC hydrometric basins
sources.authority: Environment and Climate Change Canada / Water Survey of Canada
sources.scope: July 2026 notice says gross/effective drainage areas were updated from the NHS basin delineation project and will be the source going forward.

sources.title: Water Survey of Canada Station Reference Index
sources.authority: Environment and Climate Change Canada / Water Survey of Canada
sources.scope: Official station identifiers, watercourses, DMS coordinates and gross/effective drainage-area metadata.

sources.title: Géobase du réseau hydrographique du Québec (GRHQ)
sources.authority: Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts, Québec
sources.scope: Common Québec hydrography reference. Uses BDTQ 1:20,000 in the south and CanVec 1:50,000 in the north; includes geometric flow-continuity lines. Covers all Québec.

sources.title: Géobase du réseau hydrographique du Québec à haute résolution (GRHQ-HR)
sources.authority: Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts, Québec
sources.scope: 1:2,000 LiDAR-derived hydrocoherent network deployed progressively for southern Québec; not assumed to cover northern study reaches.

sources.title: High Resolution Digital Elevation Model Mosaic (HRDEM Mosaic) — CanElevation Series
sources.scope: Continuous representation of available HRDEM data; northern source includes satellite-derived elevation. DTM/DSM and derived slope available via WMS/WCS/STAC; CGVD2013 heights.

sources.title: Canada1Water Classification of the National Hydro Network: Stream Order and Graph Refinement
sources.authority: Natural Resources Canada / Geological Survey of Canada
sources.scope: National seamless NHN-derived stream network with graph corrections and Strahler classification, distributed in regional GeoPackage models including Atlantic and Hudson.

sources.title: Kristal Farms village inventory — legacy raw evidence
sources.scope: Legacy associations between selected communities and river/hydro anchors. Tiers/priority labels are not current decision state.

sources.title: Labrador hydro potential — supplied raw evidence
sources.scope: Historical/current supplied Labrador hydro screening records. Used only as context; status/MW claims retain their own dates and review flags.

sources.title: Hydrometric Network Basin Polygons — Included stations
sources.authority: Environment and Climate Change Canada / Water Survey of Canada
sources.scope: Official station list for the basin-polygon dataset. Pass 10 confirmed all 24 Hydro Atlas station IDs are listed and retains active/discontinued status from this file.

sources.title: GRHQ ArcGIS REST — Permanent-intermittent flow-continuity lines (layer 15)
sources.scope: Polyline feature layer representing flow continuity; supports JSON/GeoJSON/PBF and exposes UDH, TYPECE, PERENNITE, FONCTION, ISOLE, O_STRAHLER, O_HORTON, LONGUEUR_M, DIST_DE_M, TOPONYME, provenance/date fields and OBJECTID.

sources.title: HRDEM Mosaic STAC API
sources.scope: Official STAC access for HRDEM 1 m / 2 m mosaic assets. Terrain extraction is allowed only after a connected reach passes manual review.

sources.title: Canada1Water stream index ArcGIS REST service
sources.scope: Registered national stream-network service endpoint supporting Canada1Water/NHN-based Labrador extraction. Exact service schema should be inspected at execution time before candidate segments are accepted.
